suggestions: I'm grateful for a PR that got approved with just a thumbs up emoji, no nitpicking today.
I'm thankful for the mosque's AC actually working during Jumaat prayers in this heat.
I'm grateful for nasi lemak that still had the sambal hit right, even from the mamak that's usually hit or miss.
I'm thankful for a client who said "take your time" and didn't follow up five minutes later.
I'm grateful for the office WiFi holding up through a deploy I really didn't want to retry.
I'm thankful for my mother texting "jangan lupa makan" when she somehow always knows I skipped lunch.
I'm grateful for a rollback script that actually worked when I needed it to, first try.
I'm thankful for the first sip of teh tarik after a meeting that ran way too long.
I'm grateful for a junior dev who asked a question that made me realize my own code was wrong.
I'm thankful for the stillness right after Subuh, before the phone starts buzzing with work pings.
I'm grateful for a Grab driver who knew a shortcut and got me home before the rain really came down.
I'm thankful for finding RM50 in an old jacket pocket exactly when the bank account was looking sad.
I'm grateful for a code review comment that taught me something instead of just pointing out a typo.
I'm thankful for my grandmother's voice note that was mostly just her laughing at her own joke.
I'm grateful for a Monday that didn't feel like a Monday, for once.
